Folder: /BP/TS-88 Feature area - Box - Attributes displaying and editing
Labels: tc-tasks-no-dates, teamembers, teamtree

Steps:
1. Navigate to the Gantt module of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-3896 Feature are - Task - Attributes displaying and editing - Tasks Without Dates - Adding one date in Edit window
   Expected: Two Jira tasks and two basic tasks are displayed on WBS.
2. Click right mouse button on taskName and click Edit
   Data: taskName: TC3896 Task Start Date
   Expected: Edit issue dialog is displayed.

   Expected: Edit issue dialog is displayed.

   Data: startDate: 18/11/2024
   Expected: The start date of the TC3896 Task Start Date have been added. On Gantt timeline task starts on 18 of November, 2024, and has no end date.
8. Click right mouse button on taskName and click Edit

9. Add the endDate and click Update
   Data: endDate: 18/11/2024
   Expected: The end date of the TC3896 Basic Task End Date have been added. On Gantt timeline task ends on 18 of November, 2024, and has no start date.
